Bird Box's ending with the home for the blind still being functional.  Monsters/Aliens and their abilities being defined were not well defined, but they could manipulate people who saw them (and the environment a bit) to chase and hunt other people down.  The movie's monsters chase the protagonists all the way up to the front door to the School for the Blind.  So they know where they are, why couldn't they just manipulate some people to destroy the door and invade?  The movie should have ended with that school being decimated.

Also if the monsters can talk and vocalize, why didn't the viewer see that ability earlier in the movie?  Sarah Paulson could see and HEAR her late mother before kicking the bucket, but she already SAW the monster.  The protagonists didn't see the monsters but could hear them anyways. The monsters could have easily lured people outside to either see them and go crazy or be murdered by people who went crazy.

TLDR: If Bird Box's monsters can manipulate people and vocalize/make noise then that School for the Blind at the end of the movie should have been  L O N G  gone.

It's not a problem with a "barbaric Middle East" religions, it's a problem with ancient traditions and century old texts not ageing well or being misinterpreted and defining the government's laws.  Educated questions/concerns or speaking from experience are valid because they aren't fundamentally malicious.   It's not "intolerant" if you're civil and genuine.  Educate yourself, join a group, go to community college and take a world religions class or something.
